command:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED_GROWBOX=07bc0aa1a53a55ff920f1f9ef028c8602fcaa182
DONOR_SHA=f17c8e59feac80d66b3036b8993ea2ac6bacac5c
DONOR="$HOME/Documents/PlatformIO/Projects/esp32s3_LiteGraph"
printf '%s\n' '=== Stage28A exact-source audit ==='
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_GROWBOX"
test -d "$DONOR/.git"
git -C "$DONOR" cat-file -e "$DONOR_SHA^{commit}"
for p in \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.h \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.cpp \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtTxBackend.h \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtTxBackend.cpp \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtRxBackend.h \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtRxBackend.cpp \
  lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RxBackend.h \
  src/features/rf433/Rf433Service.cpp \
  include/features/rf433/Rf433RxPolicy.h \
  include/platform/hardware/profiles/CrowPanelEsp32S3Common.h; do
  git -C "$DONOR" cat-file -e "$DONOR_SHA:$p"
done
printf '%s\n' '--- donor pins ---'
git -C "$DONOR" show "$DONOR_SHA:include/platform/hardware/profiles/CrowPanelEsp32S3Common.h" | grep -E 'kRf433(Tx|Rx)Pin|kPrimaryI2c|kSdSpi|kSdPowerEnablePin'
printf '%s\n' '--- donor dependency boundary ---'
for p in lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433ProtocolCodec.cpp lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtTxBackend.cpp lib/framework/hardware/rf433/Rf433RmtRxBackend.cpp src/features/rf433/Rf433Service.cpp; do
  echo "[$p]"
  git -C "$DONOR" show "$DONOR_SHA:$p" | grep -E '^#include|WorkerLifecycle|PSRAMUtils|APP_LOG|millis\(|rmt_new_|rmt_transmit|rmt_receive' | head -n 80 || true
done
printf '%s\n' '--- self-TX policy ---'
git -C "$DONOR" show "$DONOR_SHA:include/features/rf433/Rf433RxPolicy.h" | grep -E 'TemporalRxClassification|classifyTemporalRx|closedTimeWindowsOverlap|SelfTx|InterferenceDuringTx'
printf '%s\n' '--- growbox frozen hardware evidence ---'
grep -E 'shared native I2C on GPIO21/GPIO38|microSD|physical outputs/relays fake/locked' docs/CURRENT_STATUS.md
grep -E 'SCD41 \+ DS3231 on shared I2C, SDA GPIO21 / SCL GPIO38|MOSI40 / MISO13 / CLK39 / CS10 / power GPIO42|GPIO8|GPIO14' continuation.md
printf '%s\n' '--- growbox semantic/build seams ---'
grep -nE 'ClimateOutputEndpoint|ClimateRoleDriver|MappedClimateRoleDriver|ClimateSemanticActuatorOutput|setBinary|setDutyPermille' src/climate/ClimateSemanticOutput.h src/climate/ClimateSemanticOutput.cpp
grep -nE 'esp_driver_gpio|esp_driver_i2c|GROWBOX_I2C_SDA_GPIO|GROWBOX_I2C_SCL_GPIO|GROWBOX_SD_(MOSI|MISO|SCLK|CS|POWER)_GPIO' src/CMakeLists.txt
printf '%s\n' '--- Stage28A minimal port plan ---'
printf '%s\n' \
  '1. Preserve native ESP-IDF only; never import Arduino or LiteGraph service/settings/UI layers.' \
  '2. Port the transport-neutral Rf433ProtocolCodec data model/encode/decode logic first; keep protocol IDs 1..12, 1..32 bits, bounded repeat/pulse validation, 100 kHz timing semantics.' \
  '3. Port temporal self-TX classification as a small hardware-neutral policy using capture interval overlap + exact FrameKey equality; SelfTx is radio-loop evidence, not socket-state confirmation.' \
  '4. Add portable host tests for encode/decode and temporal classification before any RMT hardware task.' \
  '5. Keep GPIO8 as RF433 TX and GPIO14 as RF433 RX for CrowPanel Stage28; they are separate from frozen Stage27C I2C 21/38 and SD 40/13/39/10/42.' \
  '6. Do not port donor WorkerLifecycle, PSRAMUtils, APP_LOG, Arduino millis(), settings/HTTP/Nodeflow service, or RcSwitch wrapper. Replace time/task/memory/logging only where later native RMT backends require them.' \
  '7. Define a minimal RF transport seam below ClimateSemanticOutput: FrameKey/FrameConfig, queued/start/completed/error TX events, decoded RX capture event, and diagnostics. Do not bind a semantic climate role yet.' \
  '8. Stage28B gate remains TX->air->RX identical FrameKey classified SelfTx; no mains socket command until that gate passes.'
printf '%s\n' 'STAGE28A_RF433_AUDIT_OK'
